newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls with futures after US sales.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls with futures after US sales.

text.p: NWE gasoline fell sharply on Tuesday alongside tumbling NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures, traders said.
Tanker brokers reported five fresh fixtures from northwest Europe to the U.S. but gasoline traders said four of these were old gasoline sales.
The fifth was heard done this week and involved 25,000 tonnes of Eurograde from the Iberian peninsula at July NYMEX minus 6.25 cents a gallon, and 8,000 tonnes of CCS at July minus nine cents.
Eurograde barges traded in the morning at $208.50, $210 and $211 a tonne fob ARA, and then in the afternoon at $206. Regular gasoline was heard sold at $203.35 a tonne.

A cargo bid for Eurograde into Hamburg from a refiner, seen as high as $200 cif in the morning, had disappeared by mid-afternoon, traders said. The requirement was filled by storage material already owned by the bidder.
